tells.1: Circular battery line ('longer battery life, so they run longer on each charge') that adds no information
tells.2: Stock reassurance phrases stacked at the close ('No question is too small', 'part of the Kestrel family') plus bolded mini-headers
tells.4: Filler restatements and clichés ('go further between charges', 'step by step', 'no such thing as a silly question', 'Kestrel family')
